notes: All runs use local pinned Chinese-CLIP ViT-B/16 weights and unchanged preprocessing.
Some sample contents repeat via distinct controlled paths; all are fully encoded.
Large JPEG samples are public photo upscales to 6000x4000.
Early tuning24 batch32 labels have 24-image timed tail batches; tuning32 uses all32.
OS cache is not flushed; warmed baseline does one pre-read.
Stage seconds overlap in pipeline; throughput excludes model startup and metadata scan.
No user photos were modified and no entire drives were scanned.
